variants.title: Lock-in: imbalance signal of an AC bridge
variants.note: A bridge near balance gives a small signal almost in quadrature with the drive, at 400 Hz. Single and dual phase work as in the base experiment. Amplitude, phase and noise density are the lab's own.

variants.title: Lock-in: a dim chopped photodiode signal
variants.sample: Chopped photodiode signal, dim light (a fifth of the base signal)
variants.unknown: signal amplitude and SNR against time constant
variants.note: A fifth of the light on the same photodiode: the signal is smaller than the noise at every time constant here, so only the longest ones recover it cleanly.
